$comment: A QGIS profile described in a JSON file in the QDT formalism.

alias.description: Profile's name in an human readable form, allowing special characters.

author.description: Name of profile author and maintainer.

deprecated.description: If true, the profile is not deployed anymore. Its installed folder can also be removed from the end-user machine by the cleanup-manager job, through its 'profiles_deprecated' scope.

email.description: Email of profile's author and maintainer.

folder_name.description: Name of the profile's directory in QGIS.

icon.description: Relative path to the icon used for shortcuts.

name.description: Profile name without any special characters. Special characters breaking the command-line are forbidden.

qdtMinVersion.description: Minimum version of QGIS Deployment Toolbelt required to deploy this profile. SemVer x.y.z is recommended; x.y is accepted and read as x.y.0. If the running QDT version is older, the profile is not deployed.

qgisMaximumVersion.description: Maximum QGIS version where the profile can be deployed. SemVer x.y.z is recommended; x.y is accepted and read as x.y.0.

qgisMinimumVersion.description: Minimum QGIS version where the profile can be deployed. SemVer x.y.z is recommended; x.y is accepted and read as x.y.0.

rules.description: Logical rules based on contextual elements that condition profile deployment. The profile is deployed only if all of them are satisfied.
rules.title: Deployment rules

splash.description: Relative path to the splash image.

version.description: Profile version. SemVer x.y.z is recommended; x.y is accepted and read as x.y.0.
